checks.name: No recovery uses one fresh terminal IPC without waiting for a future retry
Owned process closure records different live and closed generations
Real callback completion preserves the earlier alive cache and waits only for that request
A fresh alive process is rejected without another sample
Missing fresh alive is unknown and rejected
Boolean PID cannot masquerade as a process number
A different closed generation is rejected
A replacement service PID is rejected
A nonzero closed PID is rejected
A new recovery during the read fails instead of resampling
A new environment generation during the read is rejected
A target reached during terminal observation is rejected
Owned rejection cannot pass without ownership evidence
A different live PID cannot be attributed to the owned process
An expired original fetch deadline performs no IPC
A late callback cannot close another case
Terminal IPC executes off the caller thread
An IPC timeout interrupts only the read adapter and never retries
An IPC exception remains unknown and cannot become closed
A successful recovery is not rejected-startup terminal evidence
A pushed replacement service cache after the correlated reply is rejected
An immediate ready result cannot be overwritten by a later blocked fence
An immediate live cache without an overlapping recovery remains failure
A live cache at the UI selection cut needs a recovery owner
A target reached while the final UI callback is queued remains failure
A case change during read cannot be attributed to the old case

scope: Complete fixture observer with explicit host UI/IPC adapters; not Android or process-exit acceptance
